$comment: Routes from the original's sitemap.xml (fetched 2026-10-27). Home sections read from src/components/*.jsx of the clone; blog index/post sections read from the live original's markup. Blog templates are not built in the clone yet (no implementedBy).

categories.SHELL: Site chrome and runtime utility UI: skip link, preloader, scroll progress, grain overlay, navigation, mobile menu, footer.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer quote strip, outcome stats, customer story, case study.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation: the problem, workflow, product demo, capabilities, trust/accuracy, reconciliation.

shell.skip-link.description: Visually hidden 'Skip to content' link targeting #main.

shell.loader.description: Full-screen intro preloader: brand label and claim-file tag, drawn seal SVG with ring text and checkmark, status line, 00 to 100 counter, progress bar, six-panel exit wipe. Plays once per session.

shell.scroll-progress.description: Fixed thin bar at the top of the viewport that fills with page scroll progress.

shell.grain.description: Fixed full-viewport animated film-grain texture overlay.

shell.nav.description: Fixed top navigation: logo and 'Claims' wordmark, six primary links with roll hover, magnetic 'Book a demo' button, burger on mobile. Hides on scroll down, switches theme over dark sections.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Dark full-screen mobile menu revealed by clip-path: numbered links, lime demo button, contact email.

shell.footer.description: Dark footer: oversized split-letter brand mark, link columns including blog guides, contact and legal line.

hero.home.description: Home hero: scrambled eyebrow and status ticker, serif headline 'Scan the file. We'll handle the claim.', lede, primary and video CTAs, animated isometric claim-desk SVG scene, spec strip.

proof.quote-strip.description: Customer proof strip with a scroll-scrubbed quote directly under the hero.

proof.results.description: (02) Dark results band 'Same claims. A lighter desk.' with odometer and counter stats.

proof.customer-story.description: (08) Dark 'In his own words.' customer testimonial video with custom cursor.

proof.case-study.description: (09) Case study teaser: a hospital cutting its claim backlog from a week to three days.

features.problem.description: (01) The claim-desk problem: cost breakdown of manual filing.

features.movement.description: (03) 'Scan and forget.' pinned, scroll-scrubbed walkthrough of a claim file moving through the steps.

features.product-demo.description: (04) 'One claim batch, start to finish.' stepped interactive product demo with auto-cycle and step buttons.

features.platform.description: (05) 'Three capabilities. No re-work.' tabbed capability panel (validate, stamp, watch) with auto-advancing tabs and screenshots.

features.trust.description: (06) 'Measured twice. Filed once.' accuracy and human-approval section with an in-view looping video.

features.reconciliation.description: (07) Payment reconciliation: stuck money, deductions, spreadsheet replacement, with animated reconciliation rows.

conversion.demo-form.description: (11) Dark demo-booking band with a lead form, inline validation and a thank-you state.

editorial.blog-hero.description: Blog index header introducing the claims guides.

editorial.post-list.description: Grid of post cards for every article.

editorial.breadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumb trail back to the blog index.

editorial.post-toc.description: Sticky table of contents sidebar for the article.

editorial.post-body.description: Long-form prose body of the article.

editorial.post-cta.description: Aside promoting a demo from inside an article.

editorial.related-posts.description: Three related post cards at the end of an article.
